name: FreeBit Co., Ltd.
summary: FreeBit Co., Ltd. operates as a supporting internet business and broadband business company in Japan. The company operates through 5G Infrastructure Support Project, 5G Lifestyle Support Project, and 5GDX Support Project for Companies and Creators segments. The 5G Infrastructure Support Project segment offers business support services for ISPs and mobile virtual network operators (MVNOs) or mobile virtual network enabler (MVNE); corporate support services for MVNOs; and cloud services for corporations.
